claim.query_family: for every future D subseteq V, whether C union D hits every inclusion-minimal patchability edge
claim.abstraction: U_C={E in H : C intersection E is empty}
claim.scope: finite carrier V and finite nonempty-edge hypergraph reduced to an inclusion-minimal clutter

theorems.query_factorization: C union D is good iff D hits every edge in U_C
theorems.full_abstraction: U_C=U_C_prime iff every future extension query has the same answer
theorems.minimality_witness: if E belongs to U_C but not U_C_prime, the extension V minus E distinguishes the states
theorems.transition: delta(U,v) deletes exactly the residual edges containing v
theorems.parameter_roles: v and w induce identical transitions iff their minimal-edge incidence signatures agree
theorems.minimal_automaton: reachable residual clutters are exactly the Myhill-Nerode states
theorems.state_count: the size of the union closure generated by parameter incidence masks
theorems.distance: distance from residual U to acceptance equals the transversal number tau(U)

limitations: obstruction generation is assumed correct and remains potentially expensive
state count may still be exponential
